description: XI'AN Aerosemi MT3608 — boost (step-up) DC-DC converter, up to 2 A continuous, 1.2 MHz fixed switching, Vout up to 28 V. SOT-23-6. The maker default for 3.7 V → 5 V or 5 V → 12 V boost rails on battery-powered projects.
name: mt3608
watch_out_for: Needs a low-V_f Schottky diode (SS14 or similar) and a ≥4.7 µH inductor rated for at least 1.5 × peak switching current. Output cap should be low-ESR (10-22 µF X5R/X7R). Vfb is 0.6 V — output divider sets Vout (Vout = 0.6 × (1 + Rtop/Rbot)). Soft-start not built in; inrush at startup can exceed steady-state by 2-3×.
